Goldstein-Speer proves only completely asymmetric direction invariance, and Juhasz et al analyze disorder-scaling asymptotics. Accessible preceding one-hole four-site result fixes rather than reverses polarity. value.rationale: The sharp field-strength rectification-polarity switch in a fixed half-filled disordered interacting ring is a motivated nonlinear transport effect. The full if-and-only-if reflection classification and unique-crossover condition connect disorder geometry with a measurable sign change not implied by existing large-system or single-vacancy formulas.
